cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm writing to apply for the Remote Long-Form Content Strategist — AI-Driven SEO/AEO role at Jobgether. The job's emphasis on answer-first delivery, schema-ready formatting, FAQs, and internal linking describes the work I already do: writing SEO content, implementing structured data, and using AI tools to scale quality output without sacrificing accuracy.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I handle on-page SEO, keyword research, and SEO content for client websites, publishing and updating pages in WordPress (Elementor, Astra, Rank Math) and tracking performance with Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, and Search Console. I also write keyword-targeted blog content for e-commerce and consultancy clients, and maintain a consistent layout across roughly 600 member profile pages for a pharmacists' association site.

Freelance, I built and optimized mirook.com for a Belgian youth chess champion. I implemented JSON-LD schema (Person, SportsEvent, FAQPage), knowledge-graph markup, and an llms.txt file, then ran iterative technical SEO/GEO audits that measurably raised the site's search-health score. On my own site, baverok.com, I designed and built a hand-coded landing page with a WebGL hero, structured data, and accessible markup. I use LLMs daily for research, content, and audits, apply prompt engineering, and connect AI tools to WordPress and SEO workflows through MCP integrations; I also use Python to automate repetitive tasks.

What draws me to this role is the chance to manage AI agents and monitor performance across both Google and AI engines — a natural extension of the GEO and AEO work I already do. I'd bring a technical, results-focused approach to producing publish-ready content at scale while keeping editorial standards high.

I'd welcome the opportunity to discuss how my experience can support your partner company's content goals.

Sincerely,
